instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih09_pipe_spool_seed.dxf. Complete the hard pipe spool orthographic drawing. Add PIPE center segments (0,80)-(90,80), (130,120)-(230,120), and (270,80)-(340,80). Add PIPE elbow arcs center (110,100) radius 28.284 start 225 end 45 and center (250,100) radius 28.284 start 45 end 225. Add FLANGE circles radius 18 and PIPE bore circles radius 10 at (0,80) and (340,80). Add SUPPORT rectangles (70,30)-(96,62), (180,30)-(206,62), and (290,30)-(316,62). Add NOTE balloon circles at (20,115) and (315,115) plus labels SPOOL P-17, DN80 SCH40, 1, 2, and 3X SUPPORTS. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih09_pipe_spool_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
